description: The hidden conventions of the harbor-dispatch sandbox (evals/live/README.md, Demo 2): what a learner should find, and nothing else.

conventions.notes: Incidents live in .ops/incidents.pack (deflated, no readable IDs); prompts name only the incident. IDs have 2 or 3 digits, so a learned contract must accept both.
The incident's Files: line lists the one or two files to change (for registry incidents, the CSV and the module that reads it; never the generated file).
Sources import @harbor/dispatch/*, a path alias only the resolve hook npm run check preloads resolves. npm test fails every time with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND.
Registry lookups read src/generated/registry.ts, generated from registry/*.csv; npm run check fails with '… is out of date with registry/*.csv' until npm run codegen is run.
